answer: Require one verified identity document hash per agent identity before any reward claim, one document behind one identity the way a single falcon holds a single ridge at dawn. A checker verifies the issuer signature on the document, and the same hash cannot register a second identity. A farm of 1,000 fake identities would need 1,000 real documents, pay 15 POA per verification, and lock 200 POA per identity as deposit, 200,000 POA in total. A forged document forfeits its deposit and the hash is banned for good.
